text: For a leaky-integrator layer with leak rate α and spectral radius ρ, the effective memory time constant is approximately:
explanation: The chapter derives τ_eff ≈ 1/(α(1−ρ)): smaller α (slower forgetting) OR larger ρ (closer to marginal stability) both lengthen memory. Option 0 is the reciprocal (that expression is the low-pass cutoff frequency ω_c, not the time constant). Options 1 and 2 do not reduce to the correct dependence and predict memory shrinking as ρ→1, the opposite of the true behavior.
